s: klI, (pAti rakzati asmAdAtmAnamiti । pA + “pAnIviziByaH paH .” uRAM । 3 । 23 । iti paH .) aDarmmam । duradfzwam । tatparyyAyaH । paNkam 1 pApmA 2 pApam 3 kilvizam 4 kalmazam 5 kaluzam 6 vfjinam 7 ॥ pApasya puruzatrayAnuvarttitvaM yaTA, -- “nADarmmaScarito rAjan ! sadyaH Palati gOriva । SanErAvarttamAnastu mUlAnyapi nikfntati ॥ yadi nAtmani mitrezu na cet putrezu naptfzu । pApamAcaritaM karmma trivargamanuvarttate ॥ PalatyevaM DruvaM pApaM guruBuktamivodare ॥” iti mAtsye 28 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ tIrTasya pApanASakatvaM tatra kftapApasya vajralepatvaYca । yaTA, -- “anyatra hi kftaM pApaM tIrTamAsAdya gacCati । tIrTe tu yat kftaM pApaM vajralepo Bavizyati ॥ maTurAyAM kftaM pApaM tatrEva ca vinaSyati । ezA purI mahApuRyA yasyAM pApaM na vidyate ॥” iti vArAhe maTurAmAhAtmyam ॥ * ॥ SezapApalakzaRaM yaTA, -- “ataH paraM pravakzyAmi SezapApasya lakzaRam । fRaM devarziBUtAnAM manuzyARAM viSezataH ॥ pitFRAYca dvijaSrezWa ! sarvvavarRezu cEkataH । o~kArAdinivfttiSca pApakAryyakftiSca yA ॥ hatyAdikaM mahApApaM tvagamyAgamanaM taTA । GftAdivikrayaM GoraM cARqAlAdipratigraham ॥ svadozagopanaM pApaM paradozaprakASanam । IrzAvidDaM vAkyaduzwaM nizWuratvaM zaqambaram ॥ QAkitvaM tAlavAditvaM nAmnA vAcApyaDarmmajaH । mAraRatvamaDArmmikyaM narakAvahamucyate ॥ etEH pApEstu saMyuktaH pacyate yadi SaNkaraH ॥” iti vAmane 58 aDyAyaH ॥ sANkaryyanAmakapApAni yaTA, -- “ekaSayyASanaM paMktiBARqapakvAnnamiSraRam । yAjanADyApane yonistaTEva sahaBojanam ॥ sahADyAyastu daSamaH sahayAjanameva ca । ekAdaSa samuddizwA dozAH sANkaryyasaMjYitAH ॥ samIpe cApyavasTAnAt pApaM saMkramate nfRAm । tasmAt sarvvaprayatnena sANkaryyaM parivarjjayet ॥” iti kOrmme upaviBAge 15 aDyAyaH ॥ “AlApAdgAtrasaMsparSAt saMvAsAtsahaBojanAt । AsanAcCayanAdyAnAt pApaM saMkramate nfRAm ॥ AsanAdekaSayyAyA BojanAt paMktisaNkarAt । tataH saMkramate pApaM GawAdGawa ivodakam ॥” iti gAruqe nItisAre 112 aDyAyaH ॥ rAzwrAdikftapApena rAjAdInAM parasparaM pApitvaM yaTA, -- “rAjA rAzwrakftAt pApAt pApI Bavati vE hare ! । taTEva rAjYaH pApena tadrAjyasTAstu ye janAH ॥ varRASramAdayaH sarvve pApino nAtra saMSayaH । BAryyAMhoduzkftI svAmI vfjinAt svAmino'balA ॥ taTA deSikapApAttu SizyaH syAt pAtakI sadA । SizyAdDi pApino nityaM gururBavati duzkftI ॥ pAtakI yajamAnaH syAt pApino'Nga ! puroDasaH । purohitastaTA pApI yajamAnAMhaso Druvam ॥” adattapuRyapApaBAgitvaM yaTA, -- “adattAni ca puRyAni pApAni ca yaTA priye ! । prApyARi karmmaRA yena tadyaTAvanniSAmaya ॥ deSagrAmakulAni syurBAgaBAYji kftAdizu । kalO tu kevalaM karttAM PalaBuk puRyapApayoH ॥ akfte'pi ca saMsarge vyavasTeyamudAhftA । saMsargAt puRyApApAni yaTA yAnti niboDa tat ॥ ekatra mETunAdyAnAdekapAtrasTaBojanAt । PalArdDaM prApnuyAnmarttyo yaTAvat puRyapApayoH ॥ sparSanAdBAzaRAdvApi parasya stavanAdapi । daSAMSaM puRyapAzAnAM nityaM prApnoti mAnavaH ॥ darSanaSravaRAByAYca manoDyAnAttaTEva ca । parasya puRyapApAnAM SatAMSaM prApnuyAnnaraH ॥ parasya nindApESunyaM DikkAraYca karoti yaH । tatkftaM pAtakaM prApya svapuRyaM pradadAti saH ॥ kurvvataH puRyakarmmARi sevAM yaH kurute paraH । patnI Bftyo'Ta Sizyo vA sajAtIyo'pi mAnavaH । tasya sevAnurUpeRa tasya tatpuRyaBAgBavet ॥ ekapaMktestato yastu laNGayan pariveSayet । tasya pApaSatAMSantu laBate pariveSakaH ॥ snAnasanDyAdikaM kurvvan saMspfSedvA praBAzate । sa puRyakarmmazazWAMSaM dadyAttasmE suniScitam ॥ DarmmoddeSena yo dravyaM paraM yAcayate naraH । tat puRyaM karmmajaM tasya DanaM dattvApnuyAt Palam ॥ apahftya paradravyaM puRyakarmma karoti yaH । karmmakft pApaBoktAtra DaninastadBavet Palam ॥ nApanudya fRaM yastu parasya mriyate naraH । DanI tat puRyamApnoti svaDanasyAnurUpataH ॥ budDidastvanumantA ca yaScopakaraRapradaH । balakfccApi zazWAMSaM prApnu yAt puRyapApayoH ॥ prajAByaH puRyapApAnAM rAjA zazWAMSamudDaret । SizyAdguruH striyA BarttA pitA puttrAttaTEva ca । svapaterapi puRyasya BAryyArdDaM samavApnuyAt ॥ parahastena dAnAdi kurvvataH puRyakarmmaRaH । vinA BftakaSizyAByAM karttA zazWAMSamAharet । Atmano vA parasyApi yadi sevAM na kArayet ॥ SrIkfzRa uvAca । itTaM hyadattAnyapi puRyapApAnyAyAnti nityaM parasaYcitAni । SfRuzva cAsminnitihAsamagryaM purABavaM puRyamatipriyaYca ॥” iti pAdmottaraKaRqe । 71 । 157 aDyAyaH ॥ kzudrajantupraBftInAM vaDe pApaM tatprAyaScittaYca yaTA, -- “vaDe ca kzudrajantUnAM hiMsakAnAYca paRqitaH । kArzApaRaM samutsfjya mftyukAle pramucyate ॥ ahiMsakAnAM kzudrARAM vaDe SataguRaM Druvam । prAyaScittaM mftyukAle kaTitaM padmayoninA ॥ vaDe viSizwajantUnAM paSvAdInAYca kAmataH । tataH SataguRaM pApaM niScitaM manurabravIt ॥ narARAM mlecCajAtInAM vaDe SataguRaM tataH ॥ mlecCAnAYca SatAnAYca yat pApaM laBate vaDe । sacCUdrEkasya ca vaDe tat pApaM laBate pumAn ॥ sacCUdrARAM SatAnAYca yat pApaM laBate vaDe । tat pApaM laBate nUnaM govaDenEva niScitam ॥ gavAM daSaguRaM pApaM brAhmaRasya vaDe Bavet । viprahatyAsamaM pApaM strIvaDe laBate naraH ॥” * ॥ pApidarSanajanyapApaM yaTA, -- “pApaM yaddarSane tAta ! kaTayAmi niSAmaya । duHsvapnaM pApabIjaYca kevalaM viGnakAraRam ॥ goGnaYca brahmaGnaM vApi kftaGnaM kuwilaM taTA । devaGnaM pitfmAtfGnaM pApaM viSvAsaGAtinam ॥ miTyAsAkzyapradAtAraM paYcAtiTyavivaYcakam । grAmayAjinameveti devaviprasvahAriRam ॥ aSvatTaGAtinaM duzwaM SivavizRuvinindakam । adIkzitamanAcAraM sanDyAhInaM dvijantaTA ॥ devalaM vfzavAhaYca SUdrARAM sUpakArakam । SavadAhI ca SUdrARAM SUdraSrAdDAnnaBojinam ॥ avIrAM CinnanAsAYca devabrAhmaRanindakam । patiBaktivihInAYca vizRuBaktivihInakam ॥ SUdrARAM viDavAYcEva caRqAlaM vyaBicAriRIm । SaSvat kopayutaM duzwamfRagrastaYca jArajam ॥ cOraM miTyAvAdinaYca SaraRAgataGAtinam । mAMsApahAriRaYcEva brAhmaRaM vfzalIpatim ॥ brAhmaRIgAminaM SUdraM dvijaM vArdDuzikantaTA । agamyAgAminaM duzwaM caturvvarRaM narADamam ॥ mAtAsapatnI mAtA ca SvaSrUSca BaginI sutA । gurupatnI puttrapatnI sodarasya priyA satI ॥ mAtfzvasA pitfzvasA BAgineyapriyA taTA । mAtulAnI navoQA ca pitfvyastrI rajasvalA ॥ pitfmAtfprasUScEva cAgamyAzwAdaSa smftAH । kIrttitAH sAmavede ca paripAlyAH satAM vraja ! ॥ etAn dfzwvA ca brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 7 । 78 aDyAyaH ॥ (anizwam । vaDaH । iti rAjAnujaH ॥ yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 8 । 32 । “tasmAt na lakzmaRe rAmaH pApaM kiYcit karizyati । rAmastu Barate pApaM kuryyAdeva ॥”)
